name: Echoes of Aether - CityStreet kit (street-level storefronts, clutter, overhead signs, HD street surfaces, decals)
generator: blender/city_street (Blender 5.2 headless + numpy; no AI images). See STREET_ASSETS.md

conventions.units: metres; FBX as the environment kit (import at scale 1, identity rotation)
conventions.axes: Unity Y up, asset front +Z. Wall-mounted assets (storefronts, AC, fire escape, hanging signs): pivot at the wall plane, they extend toward +Z.
conventions.materials: Slots named after materials: st_* / emit_st_* are defined here; all other slot names are environment-kit materials.
conventions.atlases: emit_st_signs and emit_st_interiors use authored atlas UVs (uvMode world0, tiling 1).
